name: artifact-runtime-nav-toggle-superseded-disposition
description: Records superseded hamburger menu-toggle dependencies without emitting missing-DOM-target findings when the transformer intentionally drops them in favor of core/navigation's responsive overlay, while selectors absent from the entry source remain dependency rows without becoming materialization failures.

source_reference.notes: The .nav-toggle hamburger is folded into core/navigation, so a preserved script referencing .nav-toggle is recorded as a superseded dependency row rather than a gateable missing-target finding. The same script also references .search-results, which is absent from the source entry, so it is recorded as a dependency row without becoming a missing-target finding.

legacy_comparison.reason: Runtime dependency parity is an upstream artifact compiler contract with no legacy comparison.
